hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the binary template K(a,b) by substituting the argument pair (a,b) with (n,m) to obtain K(n,m), and with (n,n) to obtain the diagonal evaluation K(n,n). The Piecewise condition only selects which specialization is active; it does not change the underlying K template.
required_assumptions: K is a binary symbolic function accepting the declared symbols n and m as arguments.
Substitution into the template K(a,b) is well-defined for the argument pairs (n,m) and (n,n).
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical subexpressions are both evaluations of the same declared binary function K; they differ only in whether the second argument is the independent symbol m or the diagonal symbol n. Thus a single symbolic kernel template explains both members by specialization.
